name: 97223 · Tigard, OR
findings: ZIP 97223 (Tigard) has 238 nonprofit organizations. 114 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97223 (Tigard) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97223 (Tigard) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 77 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
